subject: ocelot
title: An Ocelot Can Eat an Opossum. Cameras Caught Them Walking Together

scenes.text: Cameras caught a hunter strolling beside its own prey.
In the Amazon, ocelots can eat opossums. Yet trail cameras filmed the two walking side by side.
It happened four times, in different places, between 2019 and 2023.
Then researchers laid out ocelot scent. Opossums visited it 12 times. Puma scent, just once.
One idea: opossums borrow the cat's smell to hide from other predators, and the ocelot uses theirs to sneak up on prey.
So who's using whom? Scientists still don't know.

description:
Ocelots and opossums are sometimes predator and prey, but camera traps in Peru and Panama filmed them walking together.
In a scent test, opossums visited strips scented with ocelot 12 times and puma scent only once. The study was published in Ecosphere.
Who do you think is using whom here?
thumbnail_text: THE CAT WALKS WITH ITS PREY
first_comment: Opossums are resistant to some snake venom, so one theory is that the pair team up around snakes. What's the strangest animal duo you've ever seen?
